It's Great to Be an Inker!

At Custom Ink, we prioritize our team's well-being with a comprehensive array of perks and benefits designed to foster a happy, healthy, and vibrant work environment. Here's what makes being an Inker so rewarding:
Comprehensive benefits are provided for all full-time team members, including:
Health & Wellness: Low-cost Medical, Dental, and Vision, plus 24/7 virtual care, mental health support, and free generic prescriptions.
Time Off: Generous, flexible paid time off, major paid holidays, and dedicated paid time off to vote.
Family First: Up to 14 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus inclusive financial support for fertility treatments, adoption, and caregiving.
Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, employer HSA contributions, and complimentary Life & AD&D insurance up to $50k.
Career Growth: Invest in your future with tuition assistance, sponsored certifications, and continuous training programs.
We deeply understand and act on customer needs, stay alert to how competitors move, and use that insight to drive better decisions across the business.
We stay aligned on where we’re going and why it matters. We understand the full picture and make decisions in service of the whole.
We put the right people in the right seats, operate with low ego, challenge each other openly, decide quickly and move forward together.
We act with speed and ownership. We stay close to the data, engage in the details, and don’t wait for perfection when progress is needed now.
We are very curious, and value learning and understanding. We listen well, learn fast, make smart bets, and adjust with resilience.
We pursue ideas that uniquely serve our ICP customers, and use data, automation, and AI to differentiate where it matters and operate with discipline at scale.
We think of those three hearts as a daily reminder of what matters most:
❣️ Heart for Our Teams: Strong communities start with our own people. We build One Killer Team where Inkers connect, support one another, and bring their unique perspectives to work.
🤝 Heart for Our Customers: Serving as the engine for team success, we help organizations bring people together through custom gear that turns shared moments into lasting memories.
🌎 Heart for Our Communities: We support approved non-profits and schools with in-kind swag grants, helping local groups celebrate their impact and strengthen their bonds.
We’re excited for your upcoming interview and want to share CustomInk’s policy on using artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the process.

You may use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Amazon CodeWhisperer, etc.) for assessment or take-home exercises, as long as the work you submit represents your own understanding and abilities.
However, AI tools may not be used during live interviews to generate, draft, suggest, or influence your responses. All interview answers must be your own original work.
If you require assistive technology as a disability accommodation, please notify careers@customink.com in advance so we can consider appropriate, legally compliant accommodations.
